plain_english_summary: This is an annual multi-trip travel insurance policy for Europe from Harbourlight (Fictional), covering Alex Sample from 3 November 2025 to 2 November 2026 for trips of up to 31 days each. It pays for emergency medical treatment (up to GBP 10 million), cancellation, baggage, money, travel delays and personal liability, with a GBP 75 excess per person, per incident, for each section claimed. Winter sports such as skiing and snowboarding are NOT covered at all because the Winter Sports Endorsement was not purchased, and gadget cover was not bought either. Undeclared pre-existing medical conditions, claims involving alcohol or drugs, and risky activities like deep diving or riding large motorbikes are also excluded.
